Alert / other · Estonia, Finland

Drone detections and debris finds in Estonia’s Tartu County and Finland

31 March 2026 · Tartu County · Finnish border

Multi-country cluster

This retained cluster combines Estonian activity and debris reporting with a Finnish drone recovery on 31 March 2026. The Finnish final investigation locates that recovery at Pyhäjärvi in Parikkala and establishes Ukrainian origin and unauthorized entry.

The Finnish recovery is distinct from the two 29 March crashes and the later Iitti find. Its entry time remains unknown. The Estonian component remains an unresolved cluster; its sightings and objects are not converted into additional records.

Show on the interactive map →

Attribution and uncertainty

Origin / operator / attribution
Estonian assessment: Ukrainian drones intended for Russia. Finnish investigators established Ukrainian origin for the recovered Parikkala UAV.
Investigation / uncertainty
The Finnish recovery date and origin are established; its precise entry/crash time is not. The Estonian cluster still lacks track-to-object reconciliation.
